Ruling

Partial refund PARTIAL_REFUND

Refund to the rider: SGD 10.75

The judge's explanation, as written

To the rider and the driver: on the route point the rider is right, but not to the extent asked, and the correct figure is the one both parties' surviving claims converge on. Route deviation. The GPS trace EV-GPS-00106 (weight 1.0) measures 10.78 km for this trip. Against the booked optimal of 7.2 km on the trip record EV-TRIP-00106 (weight 1.0), that is an excess of 3.58 km, or 49.72% — above the 20% and 0.8 km establishment gates of POL-RD-01, so a deviation is ESTABLISHED. It stops just short of the 50% and 8.0 km materiality gates, so it is not a MATERIAL deviation: the POL-RD-06 repeat-deviation check and its full-refund uplift are not engaged, and in any event the citable fields show deviation_flags_90d 0 against 96 completed_trips_90d, i.e. no pattern. The trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07 (169 fixes, 10 s sampling, 100% coverage, no gaps), so the measured excess stands and no independent corroboration is needed. Money. The fare is METERED, so POL-RD-02 applies. recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 7.2 km + 0.28 x 19.0 min) x surge 1.0 read from the fare_breakdown + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP on the optimal route = 15.32. Refund = 26.04 charged_total - 15.32 = 10.72, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 = 10.75. That is 41.17% of the charge, well below the 90% share that would convert it into a full refund, so the rider's request for the whole 26.04 is not granted and the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 10.75. Why the $5.50 of ERP is not added on top. Both gantries — CTE (Braddell Rd towards City) SGD 3.00 and CTE (Chin Swee Rd tunnel) SGD 2.50 — are off the optimal route, and the 15.32 recomputed fare already includes only on-optimal-route gantries (0.00 here). POL-RD-09(1) comprehends that ERP inside the 10.72 difference; itemising it separately and adding it would produce 16.25, which is precisely the double count the clause forbids. No standalone pass-through correction is available either: both gantries are matched by trace fixes within the 250 m radius (0.0 m and 24.1 m) and there is no airport surcharge, so POL-RD-09(4) finds no billing-integrity defect. Why the excess is not reduced. The single chat message EV-CHAT-00106 is the rider's own objection at 08:46:30 — 'why we at havelock? bugis is behind us' — not an instruction, and its waypoint_hint is null, so POL-RD-04 and POL-RD-14 leave the measured excess intact. No pickup or dropoff amendment exists (POL-RD-05), and the vehicle is not pooled (POL-RD-12). Escalation and process. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires: the identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown (TRP-00106), the trace is unimpaired, timestamps are consistent, and the refund is far below SGD 150.00. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00106-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0); the claim that discussed it was discarded by the referee and neither side's surviving claims rely on it, so it does not carry this ruling. One procedural note: the monetary effect of SGD 10.75 exceeds the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so under POL-GEN-05 the ruling issues but the amount is held and placed in the human queue for release rather than paid out automatically. Either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

How to appeal: Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

The driver advocate

kept Under POL-RD-01 the governing distance is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, not the trip record's rounded copy: 10.78 km against a stored optimal of 7.2 km is an excess of 3.58 km, or 49.72% of optimal. That clears the establishment gates (greater than 20% and greater than 0.8 km), which the driver does not contest, but it clears neither materiality gate: 49.72% is not greater than 50% of optimal and 3.58 km is not greater than 8.0 km absolute. The deviation is therefore established but NOT material, so the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not triggered and the FULL_REFUND uplift needed to support the rider's demand for the whole $26.04 is unavailable on this record.

evidence EV-GPS-00106, EV-TRIP-00106 · clauses POL-RD-01, POL-RD-06

kept Where the deviation stands and no exculpatory clause fully excuses it, POL-RD-02 makes the remedy arithmetic rather than discretionary: recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 7.2 optimal km + 0.28 x 19.0 optimal min) x surge 1.0 recorded on the fare breakdown + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP on the optimal route = 15.32. The refund is charged_total 26.04 less 15.32 = 10.72, rounded up to the nearest $0.05, i.e. 10.75. That is a PARTIAL_REFUND of 10.75, which is 41.2% of the charged total and far short of the 90% share that would convert it into a FULL_REFUND under POL-RD-02.

evidence EV-FARE-00106, EV-TRIP-00106 · clauses POL-RD-02

kept The rider's insistence that the $5.50 of ERP be returned in addition to the distance refund is a double count and is forbidden by POL-RD-09(1). The recomputed fare already includes only gantries lying on the optimal route, and the optimal route carries 0.00 of ERP, so the whole 5.50 of off-route ERP is comprehended inside the 10.72 difference. Adding the ERP line again would produce 16.25 — exactly the arithmetic error POL-RD-09(1) exists to prevent. The ERP is itemised separately for transparency and is not added on top.

evidence EV-FARE-00106, EV-GPS-00106 · clauses POL-RD-09

kept Neither ERP line is a phantom charge that could be refunded as a standalone correction under POL-RD-09(4). The CTE (Braddell Rd towards City) gantry is matched by a trace fix at 0.0 m and the CTE (Chin Swee Rd tunnel) gantry by a fix at 24.1 m, both well inside the 250 m match radius, and the fare breakdown carries no airport surcharge at all (0.00), so no billing-integrity defect exists. Nor is POL-RD-09(2) engaged: that limb requires a POL-RD-03 exoneration for an external event, and no such exoneration exists on this record. No standalone pass-through correction is available to the rider.

evidence EV-GPS-00106, EV-FARE-00106 · clauses POL-RD-09

kept The driver's profile does not support the repeat-deviation finding POL-RD-06 requires, so none of that clause's three effects can fire. deviation_flags_90d is 0 and completed_trips_90d is 96: the first limb (3 or more flags) fails, and the second limb (a ratio of 0.05 or more with at least 40 completed trips) fails at 0.00. Limbs (a), (b) and (c) — resolution of a balanced case for the rider, the FULL_REFUND uplift, and the conduct referral — are all unavailable, and no other field on either profile may be used to ground an adverse finding against the driver (POL-GEN-01).

evidence EV-DPROF-00106 · clauses POL-RD-06, POL-GEN-01

kept Even the reduced figure does not move automatically. The monetary effect of the 10.75 partial refund exceeds the SGD 8.00 execution threshold set on this policy file, so under POL-GEN-05 the ruling is issued but not executed: the amount is held and the case is placed in the human queue for release, where a reviewer confirms execution or converts the matter to review.

Both parties' kept claims converge on the same figures, and the tribunal adopts that common ground. THE TRIP. Trip TRP-00106 ran from Blk 79 Toa Payoh Central to Bugis Junction on 17 July 2026 and was charged $26.04 on a metered fare. The trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip id TRP-00106 and open at the same pickup event (08:35:15), so the rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged. DEVIATION. Under POL-RD-01 the governing measurement is gps_trace.trace_distance_km = 10.78 km, not the trip record's rounded 10.8 km convenience copy. Against the booked optimal of 7.2 km this is an excess of 3.58 km, or 49.72% of optimal. Both establishment gates pass (greater than 0.8 km and greater than 20%), so a deviation is ESTABLISHED. Neither materiality gate passes (49.72% is not greater than 50%, and 3.58 km is not greater than 8.0 km), so the deviation is not MATERIAL and the POL-RD-06 uplift is not engaged. The driver's profile shows 0 deviation_flags_90d against 96 completed_trips_90d, so no repeat-deviation pattern exists on the citable fields in any event. The rider's demand for the whole $26.04 is therefore rejected; the correct remedy is the POL-RD-02 partial. REFUND. The fare is METERED, so the remedy is arithmetic under POL-RD-02: recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 × 7.2 km + 0.28 × 19.0 min) × 1.0 surge (read from the fare_breakdown) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP on the optimal route = 15.32. Refund = charged_total 26.04 − 15.32 = 10.72, rounded up to the nearest $0.05 = $10.75. That is 41.2% of the charge, below the 90% share that would convert it to a FULL_REFUND, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of $10.75. ERP. The $5.50 of ERP (CTE Braddell Rd $3.00, CTE Chin Swee tunnel $2.50) lies off the optimal route, which carries $0.00. Under POL-RD-09(1) that $5.50 is already comprehended inside the $10.72 difference, because the recomputed fare includes only on-optimal-route gantries; adding it again would produce $16.25, the double count POL-RD-09(1) forbids. It is itemised for transparency and is not added on top. Both gantries are matched by the trace (nearest fixes 0.0 m and 24.1 m, inside the 250 m radius) and no airport surcharge was charged, so no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity defect arises and no referral is produced. NO EXONERATION. The chat log holds one rider message at 08:46:30 ('why we at havelock? bugis is behind us'). It is a contemporaneous objection, not a detour instruction, and waypoint_hint is null, so POL-RD-04 cannot apply and, per POL-RD-14, no distance is excluded. There is no amendment under POL-RD-05 (all amendment fields null) and no pooling under POL-RD-12 (vehicle_type is RYDE_TAXI, solo_optimal_distance_km null), so the booked 7.2 km optimal stands. No traffic advisory covers this window, and no external-cause exoneration under POL-RD-03 was asserted. ESCALATION. The trace is unimpaired: 169 fixes at 10 s spacing, 100% coverage, no gaps, max_gap 0.0 — POL-RD-07(a)–(c) are not met, so POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged. Trip ids match, timestamps agree, and the refund is far below $150 and below charged_total; no POL-RD-10 trigger fires. EXECUTION AND APPEAL. The monetary effect of $10.75 exceeds the $8.00 execution threshold on this policy file, so under POL-GEN-05 the ruling issues but is not executed automatically: the amount is held and placed in the human queue for release. Independently of that queue, this is a provisional ruling and either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04. CONFIDENCE. The deciding facts rest on the trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown, all at weight_multiplier 1.0, so confidence is set at 0.90.
